    L4.1 — Bruhat-Tits tree of SL₂(ℚ_p) + Serre amalgam (CEP SL₂ op-norm substrate) #

    The (p+1)-regular tree T_p, the PGL₂/SL₂(ℚ_p) isometric actions, vertex/edge stabilizers, the Serre amalgam SL₂(ℤ[1/p]) = SL₂(ℤ) *_{B̃} SL₂(ℤ) (via PushoutI), radial functions, the adjacency operator and its spectrum [-2√p, 2√p]. Geometry substrate for the SL₂(ℤ[1/p]) operator-norm theorem. Deep bricks (the ℚ_p lattice model, the actions, Bass-Serre, the spectrum) are honest sorry.

                                                      source
                                                      def ZFib.CEP.Substrate.serreRightInclusion (p : ℕ) :
                                                      SerreBtilde p →* SerreSL2Z

                                                      Right edge embedding into the second SL(2, Z) vertex group.

                                                      TARGET (fidelity): for the literal arithmetic group SL(2, Z[1/p]) the right edge embedding must be the p-twisted (Atkin-Lehner / Fricke) conjugate of the left one (b ↦ w_p b w_p⁻¹ pulled back to Gamma0 p); with the untwisted subtype used here the pushout is the double SL(2,Z) *_{Gamma0 p} SL(2,Z), not literally SL(2, Z[1/p]). The conditional chain only consumes the amalgam-with-congruence-edge abstractly, so this carrier is admissible for QCE_p ⟹ ¬CEP; the twist is required only to identify the carrier with the genuine SL(2, Z[1/p]) (which is where Selberg/Deligne enter to prove QCE_p).
